name: Bonfire evening
note: Tell us in the afternoon and we will have the fire ready by dusk.

name: Pine forest walk
note: Easy walks of 1 to 3 hours. We will suggest a route for your group.

name: Trout fishing on the Lidder
note: Angling needs a permit from the Jammu and Kashmir Fisheries Department; we will guide you through it.

name: Aru Valley day trip
note: Meadows, forest and the start of the Kolahoi and Tarsar treks.

name: Betaab Valley and Chandanwari
note: Often combined in one day on the Chandanwari road.

name: Snow day in Pahalgam
note: Winter roads change quickly; we confirm what is open on the day.

name: Pony ride on the meadows
note: With local pony operators. We confirm the route and the rate before you go.

name: Trek from Aru
where: Kolahoi Glacier or Tarsar Lake, from Aru
note: Multi-day treks with local guides. Tell us your fitness and the days you have.
